title: Stacker

introduction.definition: A stacker builds stockpiles of bulk material such as coal, iron ore and limestone. It travels on rails beside the yard conveyor. A tripper on the yard conveyor raises the material onto the stacker's boom conveyor; the boom can slew (rotate) and luff (raise and lower) to place the material where it is needed on the pile. A counterweight balances the boom.
applications: Coal stockyards at power plants and ports
Iron ore and limestone blending beds
key_points: Boom conveyor discharges at the tip
Stacking methods: cone shell, chevron, windrow (for blending)
introduction.summary: A stacker builds stockpiles of bulk material (coal, ore, limestone). It travels on rails alongside the yard conveyor; a tripper lifts material off that conveyor onto the boom conveyor, which slews and luffs to place it on the pile in layers (chevron or windrow stacking).

foundation: Rails on a continuous foundation (ballast or concrete beam) to the specified tolerances for gauge, level and straightness; rail joints welded or tight-fished.
Design for wheel loads including wind and storm conditions; fit storm anchors/rail clamps and end stops with buffers.
alignment: Align the machine's yard-conveyor interface (tripper or feed chute) with the yard conveyor; check slew bearing level and bolt pre-tension.
piping: Power and control by cable reel (festoon or motorised reel) along the rail track; anti-collision and boom-to-pile sensors.
Dust suppression water supply and sprays at transfer points where required.
commissioning: Test travel, slew, luff and conveyor drives individually, then interlocks (slew limits, anti-collision, overload, wind speed cut-out).
Load-test the boom conveyor and record power; check stability calculations against the as-built mass.

routine.task: Walk-down: belt, chutes, spillage, cable reel.

overhaul.task: Slew bearing inspection; boom structure NDT; conveyor pulleys.

lubrication: Gearboxes: oil to grade and change interval; open gears and slew bearing: grease to schedule.
Wheels and pulley bearings: grease to schedule.

causes: Mistracking, material build-up, impact at the transfer

remedies: Measure tilt; grease; replace if limits exceeded

safety: Anti-collision with other machines; wind speed limits and storm pins; exclusion zone around the boom and pile.

script.narration: This module introduces the Stacker.
A stacker builds stockpiles of bulk material such as coal, iron ore and limestone.
It travels on rails beside the yard conveyor.
A tripper on the yard conveyor raises the material onto the stacker's boom conveyor; the boom can slew (rotate) and luff (raise and lower) to place the material where it is needed on the pile.
Typical applications include coal stockyards at power plants and ports; iron ore and limestone blending beds; bulk export/import terminals.

video_tutorials.title: Stacker — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Stacker.
Walk-down: belt, chutes, spillage, cable reel.
Check rails, wheels and buffers.
Slew bearing inspection; boom structure NDT; conveyor pulleys.
Watch for boom conveyor belt damage: spillage, belt edge wear. Common cause: mistracking, material build-up, impact at the transfer.
Watch for slew bearing wear: rocking, noise, increased tilt clearance. Common cause: lubrication failure, overload.
Watch for long-travel misalignment: wheel flange wear, crabbing. Common cause: rail misalignment, uneven wheel diameters.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
